test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to constitutional provisions, what is the maximum permissible size of a State Council of Ministers, including the Chief Minister?

options.text: 20% of the total strength of the Legislative Assembly
15% of the total strength of the Legislative Assembly
10% of the total strength of the Legislative Assembly

solution:
The correct answer is __**15% of the total strength of the Legislative Assembly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 164(1A) of the Constitution of India** stipulates that the total number of Ministers, including the **Chief Minister, in a State Council of Ministers**, shall not exceed **15% of the total number of members of the Legislative Assembly**.
